In practice, false positives and false negatives matter at the trajectory level, not only in terms of monitor F1.102:T977,方法上最重要的是一个分解框架，而不是某个复杂模型。作者构造了七种干预条件，把从原生 CoT 到完整工具 agent 的路径拆成若干可测组件。

主分解链是：NoTool-CoT → NoTool-FCStyle → Agent-NoopTool → Agent-Full。

NoTool-CoT 是普通链式推理基线。NoTool-FCStyle 只把提示格式改成 function-calling 风格，但不给工具访问，用来测量 style cost，也就是仅仅因为输出格式、角色约束、schema 变化带来的性能损失。Agent-NoopTool 在此基础上加入完整工具调用协议，但工具返回 no-op stub，不提供真实帮助，用来估计 function-calling protocol overhead。Agent-Full 则恢复真实工具执行，测量最终净效果。

在这个链条上，作者定义了三个核心量：Δ_sty，格式成本；Δ_frc，函数调用协议开销；Δ_cmp，真实计算或工具执行带来的收益。这样，CoT 与 Agent 的性能差不再是一个黑箱净值，而能被拆成“先损失多少，再补回多少”。

此外，论文还设计了几个诊断条件。Agent-OracleCalc 用金标准工具输出替代真实工具结果，给出“如果工具执行完全正确，最多能补回多少”的上界；Agent-OracleEvidence 提供干净证据，隔离语义干扰主要伤害的是证据选择还是后续推理整合；Agent-Max1Turn 限制最多一次函数调用，用来判断多轮交互究竟在帮忙还是主要增加协议负担。

数据方面，作者没有只在原 benchmark 上比较，而是专门构造了 Sem-Distractor 版本的 GSM8K 和 HotPotQA。干扰分四类：Thematic Background、Semantic Paraphrase、Parallel Entity Distractor、Hedged Uncertainty。共同特点是“语义上相关、语言上自然、但对正确推理无帮助甚至误导”，比简单随机噪声更接近真实场景。

在机制解释上，作者提出 capability overlap principle：很多看似适合用工具的样本，其实 native CoT 已经能做对，因此工具执行的边际收益只覆盖一小部分样本；但工具协议成本会作用于更大范围样本，于是净效果可能为负。最后，作者提出 G-STEP 作为轻量推理时控制方法，用来缓解这种税负。给出的片段没有完整展开 G-STEP 细节，但从描述看，它应当是在推理时更谨慎地决定是否进入工具调用流程，减少不必要的 protocol overhead。103:T966,The main contribution is a factorized intervention framework rather than a new model architecture. The authors decompose the path from native reasoning to full tool-augmented reasoning into measurable components.

The primary chain is NoTool-CoT -> NoTool-FCStyle -> Agent-NoopTool -> Agent-Full.

NoTool-CoT is the standard chain-of-thought baseline. NoTool-FCStyle changes only the prompt format into a function-calling style without granting tool access, isolating the style cost introduced by schema, role constraints, and output formatting. Agent-NoopTool then adds the full tool-calling protocol but replaces actual tool outputs with a no-op stub, estimating the protocol overhead before any useful external computation happens. Agent-Full restores real tool execution and measures the net gain from actual tool logic.

This yields three central quantities: Delta_sty for formatting cost, Delta_frc for function-calling protocol overhead, and Delta_cmp for the gain from real computation or tool execution. Instead of treating the CoT-versus-agent gap as a single black-box number, the framework asks how much performance is first lost and how much is later recovered.

The paper also introduces diagnostic conditions around Agent-Full. Agent-OracleCalc replaces tool outputs with gold answers to bound losses attributable to imperfect tool execution. Agent-OracleEvidence provides clean evidence to isolate distractor-sensitive evidence-selection failures. Agent-Max1Turn restricts the agent to a single function-calling turn to test whether extra turns help or mostly add overhead.

On the data side, the authors build semantic-distractor versions of GSM8K and HotPotQA rather than evaluating only on clean benchmarks. They define four distractor types: Thematic Background, Semantic Paraphrase, Parallel Entity Distractor, and Hedged Uncertainty. These are designed to be topically relevant and linguistically natural, but logically unhelpful or misleading.

For mechanism, the paper proposes the capability overlap principle: many cases that appear tool-amenable are already solvable by native CoT, so the marginal benefit of tool execution is limited to a relatively small subset, while protocol costs affect a much larger set of examples. The paper then introduces G-STEP as a lightweight inference-time mitigation, apparently aimed at reducing unnecessary entry into the tool-calling protocol.104:T6ac,The experimental story is clear even though the provided text does not include the full result tables.

First, on GSM8K-Sem-Distractor and HotPotQA-Sem-Distractor, native CoT and Agent-Full are compared under semantic noise. The main observation is that tool-augmented reasoning does not reliably beat native CoT and can underperform it.

Second, the factorized intervention results show that the degradation is not explained solely by bad tool outputs. There is measurable loss from adopting function-calling style prompts, additional loss from the tool-calling protocol itself, and the gain from actual tool execution often fails to compensate for those earlier losses. That empirical decomposition is the core evidence for the tool-use tax.

Third, the oracle conditions help localize the bottleneck. If Agent-OracleCalc still does not recover much, then the issue is not only tool correctness but also when the model calls tools, how it integrates results, and how distractors distort the process. If Agent-OracleEvidence improves substantially, then evidence selection under semantic noise is a major failure point. Agent-Max1Turn tests whether multi-turn interaction is useful or mostly costly; the paper's framing suggests that extra turns often add more protocol burden than benefit.

Fourth, the capability-overlap analysis explains why average gains can be negative: the subset of examples with unique tool benefit is limited, while protocol costs are widespread. Finally, G-STEP is used as a lightweight intervention to reduce the tax without retraining the model. 几类关键算子分别对应不同机制。第一类是纯压缩型变换，如 delimiter 选择、删除 filler token、把冗长结构短语替换成紧凑分隔符。这部分利用的是 BPE 非单调性和 tokenizer 差异，例如某些符号在特定 tokenizer 下比自然语言短得多。第二类是重排型变换，如把输出约束前置到 prompt 开头，利用 attention sink；把多步操作按拓扑顺序排列，保证因果可达性。第三类是增强型变换，如在结尾追加 closure block，或按 fragility 分数复制关键语义原子，利用 recency bias 和首尾位置优势。

论文里一个值得注意的点是，它没有把所有算子都当成“越多越好”。作者明确区分了 token-reducing、structure-preserving、token-expanding 三类操作，并给出形式化定义与语义保持条件 sem(τ(p)) ⊇ sem(p)。更重要的是，他们证明了若只看一组压缩算子，well-formed schema 上可保证至少 51% 的 token 压缩。这个理论结果不复杂，但足够说明该系统不是经验拼装。

方法上的另一个亮点是 format-versus-compression 分解。作者比较 JSON baseline 与文本 baseline，发现准确率与 token 数的相关性在 JSON 表示下很强，R²=0.88；换成文本表示后几乎消失，R²=0.03。这个结果支持他们的主张：决定性因素是 representation change，而不是简单缩短 prompt。也就是说，模型不是单纯“上下文太长看不过来”，而是“看不懂这种结构”。

从预训练研究视角看，TSCG 的真正价值不在规则本身，而在它把 schema 理解问题拆成了 tokenizer 友好性、位置布局、因果可访问性、关键原子冗余保护这几个可分析维度。这些维度都可以反过来指导数据合成和预训练格式设计。10e:T837,TSCG is a deterministic compiler that converts JSON tool schemas into a compact structured-text format. It is model-agnostic, requires no finetuning, and does not rely on runtime search. The system is built from eight composable operators arranged in a fixed pipeline. The design philosophy is to encode known transformer reading biases into deterministic rewrites rather than learn a schema rewriter.

The operators fall into three groups. Token-reducing operators compress the schema by choosing tokenizer-friendly delimiters, removing filler phrases, and replacing verbose structural language with compact symbolic forms. These exploit BPE non-monotonicity and tokenizer-specific token counts. Structure-preserving reordering operators move critical constraints to the beginning of the prompt to exploit attention sink effects, and reorder multi-step operations topologically so prerequisites are causally accessible. Token-expanding operators add redundancy near the end of the prompt or duplicate fragile semantic atoms to exploit recency bias and boundary-position advantages.

A strong point is that the paper does not treat all operators as uniformly beneficial. It formalizes semantic preservation, distinguishes reducing vs. reordering vs. expanding transforms, and proves a >=51% compression guarantee on well-formed schemas for the reducing subset. More importantly, the paper isolates representation change from raw compression. On JSON baselines, accuracy is strongly correlated with token count (R²=0.88), but on text baselines that correlation nearly disappears (R²=0.03). That result supports the central claim: the dominant effect is not just shorter context, but a representation that the model can actually parse.

From a pretraining perspective, the deeper value is the decomposition itself. The paper turns schema understanding into analyzable dimensions: tokenizer friendliness, positional layout, causal accessibility, and redundancy allocation for fragile semantic atoms. Those dimensions could inform data formatting and serialization choices in future pretraining pipelines.10f:T6df,The empirical section is broad enough to be credible. The authors build TSCG-Agentic-Bench with roughly 19,000 API calls, 12 models, and 5 scenarios, covering 4B–32B models plus three frontier systems. The headline result is that several small models recover from near-collapse under raw JSON schemas to usable tool-calling accuracy under TSCG. The most visible example is Phi-4 14B: from 0% to 84.4% accuracy at 20 tools, and 90.3% at 50 tools.

On efficiency, the compiler preserves 52%–57% token savings even at 100 tools, so the compression benefit does not vanish at larger catalog sizes. On heavier real-world MCP schemas, the method still yields about +5.0 percentage points, suggesting the gains are not limited to lightweight synthetic catalogs. The paper also reports external validation on BFCL with 108%–181% ARR improvements.

The ablations are the most informative part. Some operators are clearly scale-sensitive. CFL and CFO help at smaller catalog sizes but become harmful beyond around 43 tools, which suggests positional anchoring and reordering can start competing for limited attention budget in long contexts. CCP, despite being theoretically motivated, shows no measurable gain in an 11-model ablation while adding about 85–306 tokens; the authors explicitly acknowledge this. That makes the paper more trustworthy. Another useful finding is the model-specific operator-response taxonomy: operator-hungry, operator-sensitive, and operator-robust. There is no universal best configuration.

A final result worth noting is that the synthetic TAB benchmark predicts real MCP performance within 0.1 accuracy points. If robust, that means the benchmark is capturing the main failure mechanism rather than a narrow synthetic artifact.110:T444,For a skim, start with the introduction, Figure 1, the operator definitions in Section 3, and then jump to the main result tables plus the operator ablations such as Table 23. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

Focus on three questions while reading. First, how the paper turns the intuition that “JSON is bad for LLMs” into a testable claim, especially through the format-vs-compression decomposition. Second, which operators are consistently useful and which are only theoretically motivated. Third, why some operators help at small tool counts but hurt at larger ones; that scale sensitivity is the part most relevant to transformer behavior.

If you want to go deeper, Appendix E on fragility scoring and budget allocation is worth a look. It is presented as an engineering heuristic, but it maps onto a broader research question: under a fixed context budget, how should structured semantic atoms be reordered and redundantly encoded? That question extends naturally to pretraining data formats, RAG schema design, and multimodal token serialization.111:T642,Uno-Orchestra is a single causal-LM policy that emits both a task decomposition and a routing decision for every subtask. The routing unit is not just a model ID. It is a (model, primitive) pair, where a primitive is an atomic routable action: an internal reasoning mode, a multi-step skill invocation, or an external tool call. This collapses planning and dispatch into one shared backbone, instead of running a planner first and a dispatcher later.

Training has two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on a verifier-gated curriculum of 61,201 teacher-distilled trajectories from 38 public datasets, disjoint from evaluation. A notable detail is that code and tool subtasks are executed in real sandboxes, so observations are runtime outputs rather than synthetic traces. Stage two applies Agentic-GRPO on the residual hard pool. This extends GRPO to multi-turn orchestration by using structural cues from the generated plan to assign observation-level and process-level intermediate rewards, which helps with long-horizon credit assignment.

Several design choices are worth noting. First, decomposition and routing are merged because separate modules create context-passing overhead and error propagation, while a unified policy allows budget constraints to act directly on the full decision space. Second, the worker pool and primitive vocabulary are closed, which makes RL tractable and cost-accountable. Third, admissible actions are sparse: not every model supports every primitive. That turns the problem into constrained combinatorial control rather than generic free-form generation.112:T56f,The evaluation spans 13 benchmarks across math, code, knowledge, long-context, and agentic tool use, with comparisons against 22 baselines. The headline result is 77.0% macro pass@1, about 16% above the strongest workflow baseline, at roughly an order-of-magnitude lower per-query cost. That matters because it suggests the gain is not simply from using more calls, but from finer-grained selective delegation.

The training set is relatively modest: 61,201 SFT trajectories plus RL on a hard subset. That makes the improvement more attributable to action-space design and training signals than to brute-force imitation scale. The most informative comparisons are likely the following: against flat routers, which cannot assign different subtasks to different capability-cost tiers; against hand-crafted hierarchical workflows, which decompose but do not jointly optimize dispatch; and ablations removing the unified policy, verifier-gated curriculum, or Agentic-GRPO.

The abstract does not expose all implementation details such as controller size, worker pool composition, or per-benchmark breakdowns. When reading the full paper, the details that matter most are the primitive taxonomy, how cost is calibrated, how the correctness–cost trade-off coefficient is set, and how the hard pool is constructed. Those choices determine whether the method is portable beyond the reported setup.113:T430,Read it as a policy-learning paper, not as another generic multi-agent workflow paper. Three parts deserve attention.

First, inspect the action representation. The key question is how a single assistant turn encodes subtasks, dependencies, and one (model, primitive) choice per subtask. If that schema is weak, the whole method reduces to prompt engineering; if it is clean, the paper is really about structured control through a causal LM.

Second, focus on the training pipeline, especially verifier-gated curriculum construction and Agentic-GRPO. Those sections contain the practical answer to how they keep trajectory quality high and how they make multi-turn RL learnable.

Third, read the main results and ablations with a systems lens: where does selective delegation help most, does the gain come from deeper decomposition or cheaper worker assignment, and how stable is the quality–cost trade-off.

A 25–35 minute skim should be enough for the main ideas. For deeper reading, check the appendix for the action schema, primitive vocabulary, and failure cases.114:T66f,The main paradigm is Context-ReAct, which augments the standard ReAct loop with explicit context meta-actions. At each step, the agent jointly generates its reasoning trace, a set of context-edit operations, and the next tool call in one autoregressive pass. The meta-operations are applied before the next observation is appended, so the agent actively curates its working memory online.

The operation vocabulary has five atomic actions. Skip leaves the context unchanged. Compress replaces a contiguous span of prior steps with an abstractive summary. Snippet preserves an exact substring from a previous step, which is useful for numbers, entity names, quotations, or code where abstraction is risky. Delete removes a step that no longer carries value. Rollback abandons an unproductive branch by reverting to an earlier state while retaining the reason for backtracking and any transferable insight.

The key idea is not merely adding more actions. It is changing the representation of context from a uniform text log into a multi-resolution working memory. The paper also argues expressive completeness: in principle, Compress can simulate the other operations, but specialized operators reduce generation cost and fidelity loss. That is a sensible engineering choice, similar to designing a practical instruction set rather than relying on a theoretically minimal one.

The instantiated system, LongSeeker, is fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized search trajectories. The important training detail is that the data must teach not only how to search, but when to preserve exact evidence, when to summarize, and when to roll back.115:T53d,LongSeeker is evaluated on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, and GAIA. The headline numbers in the paper are 61.5% on BrowseComp and 62.5% on BrowseComp-ZH, compared with 43.2% and 46.7% for Tongyi DeepResearch, and 36.2% and 47.3% for AgentFold. These gains suggest that elastic context control matters most in long-horizon, tool-augmented search rather than in short QA settings.

The most informative experiments are likely threefold. First, comparisons against sliding-window, periodic summarization, and restart-style baselines, to test whether adaptive context editing really beats fixed policies. Second, ablations over the five operations, especially Snippet and Rollback. Those two are the clearest indicators that the method is doing more than generic summarization. Third, analyses of context length, token cost, and success rate. If the paper reports trajectory-level statistics, the important question is whether the agent maintains or improves accuracy while operating on a shorter and cleaner context.

The training scale is modest at 10k synthesized trajectories, so the result is more about the usefulness of the paradigm than about data scale. One caveat to watch is whether the synthesis pipeline bakes in a particular search style from the teacher, which could limit generalization if the evaluation distribution shifts.116:T448,This is best read as a context-interface paper rather than a benchmark paper. Start with the method section and understand exactly what Context-ReAct adds over standard ReAct. The most important part is the semantics of the five operations and the failure modes they are meant to address. Snippet and Rollback deserve special attention because they are the strongest departures from ordinary summarization.

Then read the data synthesis and training pipeline. The key question is where supervision for the meta-operations comes from and how the trajectories are constructed. If that part is weak, the whole method risks collapsing into a prompt-level heuristic.

Finally, inspect the main results and ablations with an efficiency lens: whether gains come with lower token cost, which operations are used most often, and whether failures are caused by bad compression, bad deletion, or poor search policy.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main ideas. If reading selectively, prioritize the paradigm figure, the operation ablation table, and any statistics on context length or token usage.117:T550,LCM uses a dual-state memory design:
- Immutable Store: append-only, verbatim persistence of every user/assistant/tool message; the single source of truth.
- Active Context: the prompt actually sent to the LLM each turn, composed of recent raw messages plus Summary Nodes for older history.
Older content is compacted into Summary Nodes produced by LLM summarization, but “lossless” means every summary retains pointers to the underlying raw messages, which remain reachable via tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand. The memory is organized as a high-fanout DAG stored in a transactional, indexed persistent database (PostgreSQL in the reference implementation), enabling multi-resolution traversal of session history.
Key design choice vs RLM: RLM grants the model full autonomy to write recursive scripts (high expressivity, high variance, brittle in production, plus overhead on short queries). LCM constrains memory operations into a small set of deterministic, engine-executed primitives—analogous to structured programming replacing GOTO—trading theoretical expressivity for reliability and reproducibility. It also argues why flat-file grep is insufficient for open-ended recall and why embedding-RAG can lose conversational structure; the DAG summaries aim to preserve decision provenance while still allowing targeted drill-down to ground truth.118:T630,The method has two stages. Stage 1 is agentic SFT to establish basic search-browse-answer behavior. The key is not simply fine-tuning on available traces, but aggressively cleaning them and resampling toward long-horizon trajectories. The paper argues that small models are disproportionately harmed by noisy supervision, so it filters malformed outputs, inconsistent tool traces, and poor reasoning patterns. It also increases the training weight of long trajectories so that the model learns the behaviors that actually matter for deep research: multi-step search, evidence gathering, and synthesis, rather than overfitting to short easy examples. Stage 2 is agentic RL. Instead of optimizing only a sparse final-answer reward at the trajectory level, the paper builds on IGPO and introduces turn-level rewards tailored to long-horizon research tasks. Each step is rewarded for information gain—whether the action and reasoning move the agent toward better evidence acquisition—and penalized for format violations to stabilize behavior. This is the central design choice: the method does not treat the task as a single terminal success/failure event, but explicitly rewards intermediate progress in evidence collection. That improves credit assignment and allows partially useful trajectories to contribute learning signal even when the final answer is not fully correct. The paper also analyzes tool-use patterns and finds that successful trajectories rely more on browsing than shallow search, with RL further calibrating the policy toward more effective evidence acquisition.119:T54e,The main model is DR-Venus-4B, trained entirely on roughly 10K open trajectories. According to the paper, the SFT model already outperforms most prior agentic systems below 9B on the majority of benchmarks, and the RL model improves further while narrowing the gap to 30B-class systems. The reliably recoverable quantitative facts from the provided full text are: model size is 4B; training data is about 10K open trajectories; DR-Venus-4B-SFT beats most sub-9B baselines on most benchmarks; DR-Venus-4B-RL improves over the SFT baseline. The analysis results are also important: Pass@K indicates that the capability ceiling of small deep-research agents is substantially higher than single-sample performance suggests, implying strong returns from test-time scaling. The main ablations support two claims: long-horizon trajectory resampling materially improves SFT data efficiency, and turn-level RL is much more effective than sparse trajectory-level optimization on long-horizon tasks. Tool-use analysis provides behavioral evidence as well: successful runs browse more, and RL amplifies that pattern. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark scores and deltas should not be fabricated, but the experimental message is clear: data cleaning, long-trajectory resampling, ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-02T23:14:20+00:00","category_id":"pretraining_data","cover_url":"/covers/2605_01640.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"在“高质量数据受限、算力相对充裕”的预训练场景里，重复数据（多 epoch）会带来过拟合并导致验证损失反弹；而 Chinchilla 及既有 data-repetition 扩展（如 effective-data 形式）要么默认 token 唯一、要么只能刻画收益递减，无法刻画“重复到一定程度反而变差”，也无法刻画过拟合与模型规模的交互，从而不能给出可靠的 compute-optimal 配置建议。","importance":"这是少见的、直接面向“数据约束训练”给出可操作处方（prescriptive）的 scaling law 工作：把重复带来的损失拆成“等价新数据的收益”+“随重复增长的过拟合惩罚”，并用大规模网格实验验证。结论会改变数据受限时的资源分配：重复并非越多越好，超过阈值后应把算力转投模型容量（更大 N）而不是更多 token；同时提供一个把正则化强弱（weight decay）量化为“过拟合系数”的工具，能用于比较训练配方与决定何时需要更强正则。","technical_approach":"核心建模思路是“先用单 epoch 拟合 Chinchilla，再把多 epoch 的额外损失当作可分离的 overfitting penalty”。流程：\n1) 在单 epoch（不重复）设置下拟合标准 Chinchilla 形式的 loss 与模型规模 N、训练 token D 的关系，得到基线参数。\n2) 对多 epoch 训练，把重复 token 先当作新 token：D = U_D · (1 + R_D)，用基线 Chinchilla 预测多 epoch 的应有损失。\n3) 用观测损失减去该预测，得到“重复造成的额外损失残差”，并发现该残差随重复次数 R_D 呈幂律增长，且是 superlinear（越重复越伤）。\n4) 进一步分析残差系数如何随 N 与唯一数据量 U_D 变化：更大的模型、越小的唯一数据预算，惩罚越大。基于此提出一组从简到繁的惩罚项（complexity ladder）：从 1 参数到 2 参数再到 4 参数，形成拟合质量与复杂度的 Pareto 前沿。最简形式就显著优于 prior 的 effective-data law，并且能表达“存在最优重复次数、超过后变差”。\n5) 用拟合后的 law 做处方：给定唯一数据预算 U_D 与总 compute（或总 token 预算），求使验证损失最小的 (N, R_D) 配置；关键新建议是：当重复超过某个数据相关阈值后，继续重复会提高 loss，此时应增大模型而不是继续堆 epoch。\n6) 因为过拟合被压缩到一个系数里，可以比较训练配方：例如不同 weight PF-ODE，因为任意噪声层级之间存在唯一确定路径；离散扩散没有这种路径，所以不能要求模型在一条不存在的轨迹上点对点一致。替代方案是转向 stochastic path，也就是后验桥接分布 q(x_s | x_t, x_0)。\n\n对很多离散 corruption family，尤其 masked diffusion 和 uniform diffusion，这个 posterior bridge 可以解析写出。给定更噪的状态 x_t 和原始样本 x_0，可以直接从 q(x_s | x_t, x_0) 采样一个更干净的中间状态 x_s，其中 s < t。这样，t 到 0 的恢复不再被理解为沿唯一轨迹演化，而是存在一族合法的随机路径：可以一步大跳，也可以多步细化，只要这些路径都对应同一个真实后验桥，它们在期望意义下应当给出一致的去噪结论。\n\nCDLM 的训练目标就是让时间条件预测器 f_theta(x_t, t) 与 f_theta(x_s, s) 在这种 bridge coupling 下保持一致。直观上，模型被训练成满足一种路径无关性：从更噪状态直接预测，应该等价于先按真实桥接分布跳到更干净状态，再完成更容易的去噪任务。这样训练后，few-step generation 不是额外蒸馏出来的近似能力，而是 path-equivalence 的直接结果。\n\n这和已有方法的区别很关键。标准 masked diffusion 只学局部相邻时间步的去噪，长程跳跃能力弱，所以采样步数一少就掉质量。progressive distillation、SDTT、DUO-DCD 这类方法通常需要 teacher 轨迹或多阶段蒸馏，把多步过程压缩成少步。CDLM parameterization 设计，denoiser 也可以成为一等公民；二是给“离散 Tweedie 公式”提供了一个具体可行的构造，这对未来做离散 token 生成、图像 token、音频 codec token、甚至某些 ordinal tokenizer 的统一建模有启发。贡献更偏理论与生成建模基础，不是当前 LLM pretrain pipeline 可直接落地的方案。","technical_approach":"核心做法是引入 Binomial flows。作者的出发点很明确：在连续空间里，高斯噪声之所以特殊，不只是因为它好加噪，而是因为它让 denoiser 与 score 之间存在 Tweedie 关系，从而把训练目标和采样过程接起来。离散空间缺的正是这个桥。对于定义在非负有序空间上的数据，作者提出用 Binomial noising 作为高斯噪声的离散对应物。\n\n具体上，论文先定义一族从干净样本 X_T 到中间时刻 X_t 的条件分布 p_{t|T}，要求满足三个标准性质：容易采样；t=T 时退化为原样本；t=0 时完全忘掉原样本。然后在这个 flow 上训练 denoiser m(t,x)=E[X_T|X_t=x]，训练目标是带时间权重的 Bregman divergence。这个部分和连续 diffusion 中“直接回归 clean target 的条件期望”是平行的。\n\n关键创新在后面三步：\n1. 证明在 Binomial noising 下，denoiser 满足离散版 Tweedie 公式，可以从 denoiser 恢复与当前扰动分布相关的 score-like quantity；\n2. 利用这个关系，把采样过程写成 Poisson-Föllmer process，从纯噪声在有限时间内精确到达目标分布，而不是只给一个启发式反向链；\n3. 推导出一个涉及 denoiser 的似然恒等式，因此模型不仅能生成，还能做 exact likelihood estimation 和相应训练。\n\n这和常见离散 diffusion 的区别很明显。很多离散方法直接学习 p(x_0|x_t)、离散 score、或跳转 rate matrix，采样时依赖近似反向过程。这里作者强调的是：选对 noising family 后，denoiser 本身就足够支撑训练、采样和似然三件事，结构上更接近连续 diffusion 的统一配方。\n\n需要注意的是，这个框架依赖“非负、有序、ordinal”结构。它不直接覆盖无序类别空间，因此离文本 token 这种 nominal discrete space 还有距离。若想迁移到 LM，需要额外的 token ordering 或分解结构，这不是论文当前解决的问题。","experiments":"实验部分验证了三件事：\n1. 在合成数据上，Binomial flow 的理论关系可以被数值验证，说明 denoiser→sampling→likelihood 这条链条是闭合的；\n2. 在真实数据上，方法能得到有竞争力的生成质量，摘要里明确提到 imaging data (SPMD) paradigm, which requires tight coupling across accelerators. Due to this coupling, transient slowdowns, hardware failures, and synchronization overhead stall the entire computation, wasting significant compute time at scale. While recent distributed methods like DiLoCo reduced communication bandwidth, they remained fundamentally synchronous and vulnerable to these system stalls. To address th","starred":true,"priority":"p1","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"inbox:feishu","sources":["inbox"],"published_at":"","category_id":"llm_pretrain","cover_url":"/covers/2604_21428.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":[],"summary":{"core_problem":"论文要解决的是大规模预训练中的“强同步脆弱性”。标准 SPMD 训练把数据并行、张量并行、序列并行等计算组织在一个全局同步程序里，每一步都要求所有设备拥有一致的参数视图。这个设计在小规模时简单可靠，但在预训练规模上会把单点慢卡、链路抖动、节点故障放大成全局停顿。已有 DiLoCo 通过每 H 步同步一次降低通信量，但仍是同步协议，故障和 straggler 仍会阻塞整个训练。Decoupled DiLoCo 的核心问题是：能否牺牲严格的即时一致性，换取训练可用性和分区容忍能力，同时不明显损失最终模型质量。","importance":"这篇工作的价值不在于提出一个新的 loss，而在于把预训练系统的容错目标重新放到算法设计里。对基座模型训练来说，goodput 往往比单步吞吐更接近真实成本：集群越大，硬件故障越常态化，严格同步带来的闲置和重启会吞掉大量预算。Decoupled DiLoCo 给出了一条介于纯 SPMD 和完全去中心化训练之间的路线：多个 learner 独立前进，周期性、异步地做参数调和。它延续了 DiLoCo 的“局部优化 + 外层优化”思想，但把通信从同步屏障改成异步协调。影响主要在训练基础设施和大规模预训练方法交界处：如果这类方法在更大模型、更长训练、更复杂 MoE 上稳定成立，训练范式会从追求全局 step-level consistency，转向管理参数陈旧度、同步频率、learner 故障隔离和外层优化器稳定性。","technical_approach":"方法把全局集群拆成 M 个相对独立的 learner。每个 learner 维护自己的模型副本 θ_m，用常规 inner optimizer，例如 AdamW，在本地数据 shard 上连续训练 H 步。同步时不直接做普通权重平均，而是沿用 DiLoCo 的外层更新：把本地参数与参考参数之间的差 Δ_m 视作 outer gradient，再由 outer optimizer 聚合并更新全局参数。原始 DiLoCo 每 H 步全量同步一次，Streaming DiLoCo 又把参数切成 P 个 fragment，在不同 offset 上分片同步，以降低峰值带宽，并允许小延迟 τ。Decoupled DiLoCo 的关键变化是去掉同步屏障：learner 不必等待所有其他 learner 到达同一时刻，也不因某个 learner 失败而停住。系统侧引入 central synchronizer 做异步参数 reconciliation。每个 learner 持续发送本地参数差或分片差，并在之后接收合并后的外层更新。这样故障的影响被限制在单个 learner 或局部资源内，而不是扩散到整个 SPMD 作业。算法取舍很清楚：它接受参数视图在短时间内不完全一致，用外层优化器、同步间隔 H、fragment 粒度 P、通信延迟 τ 和更新调度来控制漂移。相比 elastic SPMD，它不是在故障后重组一个仍然强同步的作业，而是让大部分 learner 在故障期间继续贡献训练进展。相比简单异步 SGD，它保留了 DiLoCo 的局部多步训练和外层优化结构，更适合大模型预训练中高带宽、低频同步的约束。","experiments":"实验主线是验证三个问题：异步 learner 是否会损伤预训练质量；这种设计在 dense 和 MoE 架构上是否都可用；故障压力下的 goodput 是否显著优于强同步训练。论文报告 Decoupled DiLoCo 在多种模型与计算规模上，与标准数据并行训练达到相近的下游表现，覆盖文本评测和多模态评测，并包含 dense 与 Mixture-of-Experts 模型。还检查了预训练后的 post-training 能力，结论是异步预训练没有明显阻碍后续对齐或指令调优能力。系统实验采用 chaos engineering 思路，持续注入硬件故障或 learner problem in large-scale pre-training: strict step-level synchronization makes the whole job fragile. Standard SPMD training requires all accelerators to share a consistent parameter view at every step. At modern cluster scale, a slow device, a transient network issue, or a node failure can stall the entire run. DiLoCo reduced communication by synchronizing every H local steps, but it remained a synchronous protocol. Decoupled DiLoCo asks whether pre-training can relax immediate consistency, keep most workers training through failures and partitions, and still preserve final model quality.","importance":"The contribution is mainly at the boundary between training algorithms and pre-training systems. It shifts the optimization target from per-step throughput under ideal conditions to goodput under realistic failures. For large foundation-model runs, this distinction matters: rare device failures become routine events when the job spans many accelerators for weeks or months. Decoupled DiLoCo extends the DiLoCo idea of local optimization plus outer optimization into an asynchronous training framework. If the empirical behavior holds at larger scales, it suggests that future pre-training stacks may manage staleness, learner isolation, and asynchronous reconciliation instead of enforcing global consistency at every step.","technical_approach":"$34","experiments":"$35","reading_guide":"Start with the Introduction and Figure 1, since they frame the main design choice: the goal is not only lower communication, but training availability under failures. Despite its importance, existing approaches lack fine-grained length modeling, operating primarily at the coarse-grained sequence level. We introduce the Length Value Model (LenVM), a token-level framework that models the remaining generation length. By formulating length modeling as a value estimation problem and assigning ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-04-29T17:09:21+00:00","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2604_27039.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇论文要解决的是生成长度的 token 级建模问题。现有长度控制多依赖 prompt、序列级长度惩罚，或生成前的长度预测器；这些方法只能在整段回答层面施加约束，不能描述生成过程中每一步离结束还有多远，也难以捕捉中途从短回答转向长推理的动态变化。","importance":"对预训练研究的启发在于，它把长度建模写成一个可规模化的 value pretraining 问题。监督信号不需要人工标注，也不依赖 reward model；每个 token 位置都能构造训练目标，因此比序列级长度标签更密集。它不是通用价值模型，也没有证明能直接改善 RLHF 或推理能力，但提供了一个清楚的例子：一些训练信号可以从生成轨迹本身自动构造出来，并作为 token 级辅助目标服务于推理成本控制、长度控制和 RL 中的 baseline 设计。","technical_approach":"LenVM 将剩余生成长度建模为折扣回报。具体做法是：每生成一个 token 给一个常数负奖励，直到 EOS；当前位置的目标值是未来这些负奖励的折扣和。这样原始剩余长度被映射到有界、单调的标量空间，避免直接回归从几个 token 到 32k token 以上长度时的数值条件问题。模型在主干 LM hidden state 上增加一个 LenVM head，预测当前位置的长度 value。训练目标来自采样 completion 的 Monte Carlo return，在固定 rollout policy 下是对应 value target 的无偏样本。推理时，它可以用于两类操作：一是预测当前状态的剩余长度，二是通过 value-guided decoding 或 exponential tilting 调整 token 分布，在质量和生成长度之间移动。附录还把 LenVM 写成 PPO 风格长度目标下的 value function，并讨论它作为 potential-based reward shaping 的形式优势，相比序列级长度惩罚，它能给每一步提供更局部的训练信号。","experiments":"实验主要验证 LenVM 是否学到了稳定的 token 级长度信号。论文在长度控制任务上评估 Equal To、At Most、At Least 等硬约束，使用 Existing methods usually operate through prompts, sequence-level length penalties, or pre-decode predictors. They can constrain the final response only coarsely, and they do not describe how far each intermediate decoding state is from termination.","importance":"The useful idea for pretraining research is to cast length modeling as scalable value pretraining. The signal is annotation-free, does not require a reward model, and provides a target at every generated position. This is not a general-purpose value model, and the paper does not show downstream RL gains. Its contribution is narrower: it shows how a dense token-level auxiliary signal can be derived from rollouts themselves and then used for length control, inference-cost trade-offs, and potentially as a baseline in RL-style training.","technical_approach":"LenVM defines remaining length as a discounted return. Each generated token receives a constant negative reward until EOS, and the value at a decoding state is the discounted sum of future negative rewards. This maps raw remaining lengths, which may range from a few tokens to more than 32k tokens, into a bounded monotone target space. A scalar LenVM head is attached to the LM hidden states and trained to predict this return. Under a fixed rollout policy, the realized return from sampled completions is an unbiased Monte Carlo target for the corresponding value. At inference time, the predicted values can be used for length prediction, length-guided decoding, and exponential tilting of the token distribution to trade response quality for shorter or longer generations. become central in large-scale LLM inference: KV cache management is not merely a capacity issue, but a three-way mismatch. First, existing frameworks do not provide unified KV sizing across attention variants, especially for MLA-style compressed KV representations, which leads to severe over-allocation and reduced batch size. Second, most serving stacks effectively treat KV cache as an HBM-only object, leaving CPU DRAM, CXL memory, NVMe, RDMA, and parallel filesystems outside a coherent placement policy. Third, eviction remains largely reactive, typically LRU-like, despite the fact that many reuse patterns are predictable: repeated system prompts, recurring tool-call traces, and sequential locality induced by RoPE.","importance":"This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for foundation-model research in two practical ways. First, attention architecture choices should not be evaluated only by training-time quality and FLOPs; their serving-time KV representation must also be modeled correctly by the runtime stack. The paper makes this explicit by putting MHA, GQA, MQA, and MLA under one sizing framework. Second, long-context and agentic workloads are turning the bottleneck from parameter storage into state management. For researchers working on long-context pretraining, KV compression, latent attention, or memory-aware architectures, the paper is useful because it shows what system support is required for architectural gains to materialize in deployment.","technical_approach":"$3a","experiments":"The evaluation is largely analytical and system-level rather than a fully demonstrated production deployment. On an analytically modeled 64-GPU H100 cluster, the system projects 4,150 tokens/s/GPU at $0.43 per million tokens, about 2.0x the throughput of the best latency-optimized baseline in the paper (TensorRT-LLM) at 30% lower cost, and 6.4x the throughput of FlexGen with 11x lower TTFT P99. on their types and pipeline stages to achieve n","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-01T09:39:03+00:00","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2605_00539.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.DC"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是分布式 LLM 训练里两个最难同时压下去的内存项：激活和梯度。已有方法里，activation checkpointing 能省显存，但会带来明显重算开销；8-bit activation quantization 和 FP8 gradient communication 能进一步省内存和带宽，但一旦把精度继续压到接近 4-bit activation、8-bit gradient storage，就很容易出现收敛变慢、训练不稳、最终精度掉点。论文要解决的不是单点压缩，而是在 Megatron/ZeRO 这类真实大规模训练栈里，把低比特激活存储和低比特梯度存储+通信做成可用方案，并且尽量不改训练配方、不牺牲收敛。","importance":"对预训练研究的意义主要在工程可行性，而不是提出新的建模目标。它给出的价值有三层。第一，激活通常是长序列、大 batch 训练时最大的显存项，若能把平均激活存储压到接近 4 bit，就直接扩大了可训练上下文、micro-batch 和并行配置空间。第二，梯度不再只是在通信前临时压缩，而是直接以 8-bit 形式存储并参与本地累积，这比传统“高精度存储+低精度传输”的方案更进一步，能同时减内存和通信。第三，这套方法强调和 ZeRO、PP、TP 兼容，说明作者关注的是训练系统里的真实瓶颈，而不是脱离框架的 isolated kernel 优化。对做大规模预训练的人，启发点在于：低比特训练不是只能从权重和 optimizer state 入手，activation/gradient 的误差预算也可以按层、按阶段、按通信路径精细分配。","technical_approach":"方法分成两部分。第一部分是 LAAQ，layer-aware activation quantization。作者没有对所有激活一刀切地用统一 4-bit，而是先分析不同层、不同算子、不同 pipeline stage 对量化误差的敏感性，再分配不同 bit-width。文中动机很明确：Transformer 里 attention、MLP、LayerNorm、残差路径的数值分布和误差放大方式不同，统一量化会把最脆弱的那部分先打坏。LAAQ 的做法是把激活按层类型和训练流水线位置分类，对更敏感的激活保留更高精度，对相对鲁棒的部分压到更低 bit，从而把平均存储成本做到“近 4-bit”，但避免真正全局 4-bit 带来的训练崩坏。这里的关键不是单纯 mixed precision，而是把 activation quantization 变成结构感知的分配问题。\n\n第二部分是 QuanGrad，用于 8-bit 梯度存储和通信。已有很多 gradient compression 工作只压缩 All-Reduce 流量，但本地梯度缓冲和累积仍然是 FP16/FP32，所以显存并没有实质下降。QuanGrad 更激进：梯度以 FP8 形式存储，用于 local accumulation，同时设计了 precision-preserving 的 8-bit All-Reduce。论文强调的问题是，直接在 FP8 上累积梯度会因为舍入误差导致收敛变慢，因此他们引入缩放和误差控制机制，尽量保留梯度累积的有效精度，并让通信路径也维持同一低比特表示，避免反复 cast 带来的额外代价。和 Microsoft 之前只做 FP8 gradient 的方案相比，这里更强调 accumulation 稳定性和端到端系统收益。\n\n从系统集成角度看，AGoQ 不是替代 ZeRO 或 Megatron，而是叠加在现有并行训练框架上：activation 侧减少前向保存开销，gradient 侧减少反向缓冲和 All-Reduce 负担，optimizer state 还可以继续配合 8-bit optimizer quantization。这样的设计比较务实，因为它不要求改动训练目标或优化器主流程，迁移成本相对可控。","experiments":"实验覆盖 8B 到 34B The main failure modes are distributional. Per-channel LLM weights are usually unimodal and quasi-Gaussian, which is poorly matched to a binary ±1 codebook. Activations have heavy tails and extreme outliers, so low-bit activation quantization is dominated by a small number of large values. Existing binarization methods often keep activations in high precision, which limits real end-to-end acceleration.","importance":"The work is primarily an inference-efficiency contribution, but it is still informative for pretraining researchers. It frames low-bit model quality as a joint property of weight geometry and activation statistics, not just a local weight reconstruction problem. This matters for low-bit pretraining and BitNet-style model design: a training recipe that naturally produces bimodal weights and controlled activation tails should be easier to quantize than a standard dense model repaired after training. The contribution is methodological within PTQ rather than a new pretraining objective.","technical_approach":"BWLA inserts an orthogonal transformation around linear layers. Because an orthogonal matrix satisfies R^{-1}=R^T, the transformation can be paired across weights and activations while preserving the original forward computation. Orthogonal-Kronecker Transformation, or OKT, optimizes a gradient-free objective that encourages weights to form symmetric bimodal clusters aligned with the {-1,+1} codebook. The orthogonal matrix is solved through an EM-style conditional minimization, and a Kronecker factorization represents the large transform using two smaller orthogonal matrices. This keeps the PTQ overhead small. The same transform also acts on activations and reduces the effect of outliers. Proximal SVD Projection, or PSP, adds a lightweight low-rank correction in the transformed coordinate space, using a proximal upper bound and truncated SVD to absorb remaining outliers. Compared with BiLLM and ARB-LLM, BWLA is not only weight-centric. Compared with BitNet a4.8, it avoids full quantization-aware training.","experiments":"The visible text establishes the main regime as W1AX, for example 1-bit weights with 6-bit activations. The baselines discussed include BiLLM and ARB-LLM for post-training binarization, and BitNet a4.8 as a QAT-based reference for 1-bit weights with 4-bit activations. The motivation study shows that existing binary-weight PTQ methods degrade sharply once activations are also quantized to low precision, which explains why many of them retain full-precision activations. The paper also cites LLaMA2-70B requiring more than 120 GB at FP16 as the deployment pressure point. The provided manuscript excerpt does not include the final numerical tables, perplexity values, task scores, or ablation numbers; the reported claim is that BWLA outperforms prior PTQ methods across multiple LLMs under pure post-training quantization.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 20–30 minutes. 依赖的可提前终止条件就失效了。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在不改模型结构、不增加推理参数的前提下，让蒸馏模型既保留蒸馏收益，又重新具备可用的中间退出点。","importance":"对预训练/压缩研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它指出了一个常被默认可组合、实际却互相牵制的训练—部署接口问题：蒸馏目标会塑造层间表征几何，而这种几何直接决定 early exit 是否成立。这一点对做小模型预训练、蒸馏、mid-training 目标设计的人都有参考价值。第二，它给出的修正方式很轻：不是引入额外退出头，也不是改 层对齐教师第 π(l) 层，常见于 MiniLM、TinyBERT 一类 layer-aligned KD。这样的目标会让每层都承担独立功能，导致 contraction ratio 近似 1，也就是层间变换幅度没有随深度单调减小。early exit 需要的恰恰相反，是后层逐步收敛到稳定表示。\n\nLEAP 的做法不是放弃蒸馏，而是在原有 final/output matching 与 intermediate matching 之外，再加一个 exit-aware loss，让每个中间层都被训练成“潜在可退出点”。具体有两个对齐目标：一是中间层表示接近教师最终层表示，二是中间层表示接近学生自身最终层表示，其中后者用 stop-gradient 保持训练稳定，避免所有层一起塌缩到一个不断漂移的目标。损失形式采用带 soft margin 的 sigmoid 约束，并设置训练阈值 τ=0.98，要求中间层与最终层的余弦相似度足够高。总的 exit loss 为教师终层对齐项加上 0.7 倍的学生终层自对齐项，平衡质量与推理时自一致性。\n\n此外，作者还加入 batch 内相似度结构蒸馏，即 contrastive KL，让学生保留教师 embedding space 的相对几何。和传统 attention/hidden-state KD 相比，这里更偏向 sentence studies a practical incompatibility between two efficiency techniques that are often assumed to compose: layer-wise distillation and convergence-based early exit. In standard layer-aligned distillation, each student layer is trained to match a corresponding teacher layer. This spreads useful computation across the full depth of the student and suppresses the progressive representational convergence that early-exit methods rely on. As a result, distilled models may satisfy superficial exit checks but still fail to reduce effective depth or latency in deployment. The core problem is how to train a distilled transformer so that it remains compact and accurate while also exposing genuinely usable intermediate exit points, without changing the architecture or adding inference-time parameters.","importance":"The main value is not a new backbone, but a clean training-objective diagnosis. It shows that deployment behavior can be determined by the geometry induced during distillation: if the objective enforces per-layer specialization, convergence-based early exit becomes structurally unlikely. That is a useful lesson for pretraining and compression work more broadly. Efficiency mechanisms are not always modular; some combinations fail because their optimization targets encode conflicting assumptions about layer dynamics. LEAP also suggests a lightweight remedy: instead of adding exit heads or runtime controllers, one can bake “exitability” into training by shaping intermediate representations toward the final one. The contribution is moderate in scope, but the mechanism is concrete and operationally relevant.","technical_approach":"$3e","experiments":"$3f","reading_guide":"Start with the introduction and the main motivating figure. 开销。","importance":"它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-training / inference-time efficiency，但对基座研究仍有两个启发。第一，它把“推理 token 是否都值得由大模型生成”这个问题显式化了，提出能力密集部分与表达密集部分可以分离，这对未来设计 latent reasoning、分层解码、异构 MoE z，再由小模型 m 在 x 和 z 条件下生成最终答案 y。若把 z 具体实现为 reasoning trace，那么大模型承担高难度推理，小模型负责把 reasoning signal 转成答案。\n\n方法的关键不只是串联两个模型，而是联合训练目标。作者把问题写成带预算约束的优化：在保证期望奖励的同时，限制中间序列 z 的期望长度不超过预算 B。为此引入长度惩罚项，并采用交替优化训练两个模型。摘要和正文片段里提到两个稳定训练的重要部件。\n\n第一是 marginal-utility reward。只有当小模型单独完成任务可能失败，而大模型给出的 z 确实能改善结果时，大模型才会因为生成这些中间 token 获得正向激励。这样做是为了避免大模型无差别地输出长推理链，也避免 z 退化成对小模型无帮助的冗余文本。换句话说，奖励不是鼓励“多想”，而是鼓励“只在有边际收益时提供必要信息”。\n\n第二是 adaptive length-penalty schedule。固定长度惩罚往往不稳定：惩罚太弱，z 会变长；惩罚太强，协作机制还没学会就被迫压缩，性能先崩。自适应调度的作用，是在训练过程中逐步把系统推向更紧的 token 预算，同时维持可学性。\n\n从框架上看，DUET 与常规 CoT distillation 的区别在于：不是让小模型模仿大模型完整推理，而是让大模型学习输出一种对小模型“足够且更短”的通信表示。它也不同于 speculative decoding 或 routing，因为这里的大小模型不是验证—提议关系，而是语义分工关系。","experiments":"实验集中在高难推理 benchmark，如 AIME 和 th","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-04T19:48:40+00:00","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2605_03109.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是单 batch、自回归解码阶段的一个老问题：Transformer 推理往往不是算力受限，而是显存带宽受限。每生成一个 token，都要反复从 HBM 读取大矩阵权重，线性层的读带宽成本近似是 O(Ld^2)。已有方法多从权重侧下手，比如量化、静态低秩分解、剪枝；它们要么只能减少每个参数的字节数，要么依赖离线近似，难以根据当前输入动态决定哪些权重读取其实是多余的。论文的核心判断是：在固定层上，真实激活并不会铺满整个 d 维空间，而是集中在一个低维子空间里；因此，对当前输入分布真正有用的，不是完整权重矩阵 W，而是 W 在该子空间上的像 WV_k。问题就变成：能否在线跟踪这个子空间，并在不明显改变输出分布的前提下，只读取与该子空间相关的低秩权重像，从而减少带宽读写。","importance":"对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练算法，而在于它把“激活流形低维”这个表征性质，转成了可执行的推理系统设计。这个角度比静态权重压缩更接近模型真实运行时的输入依赖结构。若这个假设在更大模型和更长上下文下持续成立，它提示了一个重要方向：模型的有效推理参数量可能远小于总参数量，而且这个“有效参数量”是随输入变化的。对预训练研究员来说，这有两层启发。第一，训练时是否可以显式塑造更稳定、更低维的层内表示，从而让后续推理更容易做动态低秩化。第二，评估模型容量时，不能只看参数总数，还要看不同输入分布下的有效激活维度。贡献量级上，这篇更像一篇扎实的 inference-side 方法论文，而不是改变训练范式的工作；但它把 activation subspace、动态门控、带宽 roofline 三件事连在了一起，思路是清楚的。","technical_approach":"方法名是 Gated Subspace Inference，基本机制可以拆成三步。第一步，在每一层维护一个在线更新的正交基 V_k^(l)，用于近似该层当前 token 激活所在的 k 维子空间。论文沿用 SSI 中的 DGKS rank-1 更新，在时间维上逐 token 扩展或修正这个基，而不是预先离线估计一个固定 PCA 子空间。这样做的原因是解码过程中的激活分布会随上下文变化，静态子空间容易失配。\n\n第二步，对该层所有线性映射共享同一个子空间基，包括 attention 的 Q/K/V 投影、输出投影，以及 MLP 的 up/down 投影。对任意线性层 y=Wx，先把输入分解成 x=V_kg+r，其中 g=V_k^T x，r 是残差。然后预缓存低秩权重像 M=WV_k。若只走快路径，则输出近似为 y≈Mg，只需读取 M 而不是完整 W，带宽从 d_out×d 降到 d_out×k。相比 SSI 只覆盖 MLP 两个投影，GSI 把 QKV 和 O 也纳入，覆盖了更大比例的线性层带宽开销。\n\n第三步，用一个逐 token 的门控决定是否需要计算残差修正 Wr。门控信号来自残差相对范数 ρ_t=||r_t||/||x_t||。当 ρ_t 足够小，说明当前激活几乎落在子空间内，只用 Mg 就够；当 ρ_t 超过阈值，再回退到慢路径，计算完整 Wx 或至少补上 Wr。论文强调这个 gate 不是为了做启发式稀疏，而是为了把输出分布误差控制在给定容忍范围内。也就是说，它试图在“近似计算”和“分布保持”之间给出一个可调旋钮。\n\n和已有方法相比，差异主要有三点。其一，不做静态权重低秩分解，而是做输入相关的 activation-conditioned 低秩化。其二，不是神经元级或元素级 sparsity，而是连续子空间上的压缩。其三，不是无条件近似，而是加了 residual-aware gate，允许在难 token 上退回精确计算。这个设计比纯低秩近似更稳，也更适合语言模型里 token 难度分布很不均匀的场景。","experiments":"论文在三类模型上做了验证：GPT-2 124M、GPT-J 6B、OPT 6.7B，硬件平台是 AMD MI300X。摘要给出的核心结果是线性层权重读取的有效加速达到 3.0× 到 10.5×，同时 Omni-Flow。它不是把多模态输入简单拼接，而是把视觉流、音频流、文本输出、语音输出都对齐到共享时间轴上，让感知和响应在 token 级别并行展开。这样模型在说话时仍能继续“看”和“听”，并根据新上下文调整后续生成。这个设计针对的是传统 turn-based MLLM 的结构缺陷：后者通常把输入编码完，再一次性进入生成阶段，天然不适合 full-duplex interaction。\n\n架构上，MiniCPM-o 4.5 是端到端 omni-modal 模型，包含三部分：流式视觉/音频编码器、LLM backbone、以及语音解码模块。语音侧又分成离散 speech token 的自回归解码器，以及把 speech token 转成波形的 streaming flow-matching decoder。作者强调从多模态编码器到 LLM 再到 模式下分辨率上限较低，以换取实时性；传统模式下则允许更高分辨率。语音生成部分的关键不是普通 TTS，而是 time-aligned interleaving speech generation：输出语音 token 的生成要和并发环境上下文保持时间对齐，避免模型在持续交互中“说的是上一拍的世界”。此外，模型支持 multimodal system prompt，包括文本和参考音频，因此可以做 框架上加入 text-conditional predictor，形成 TC-JEPA。基础结构仍是 teacher-student 式 JEPA：在线编码器提取上下文 patch 表征，EMA target encoder 提供被遮挡 patch 的目标特征，predictor 根据上下文和 mask token 预测目标 patch 表征。\n\n核心改动在 predictor 侧。作者没有把整句 caption 压成一个全局向量，而是设计了细粒度 text conditioner，在 predictor 的多层中对文本 token 做稀疏 cross-attention，用文本去调制目标 patch 的预测特征。这样每个待预测 patch 可以选择性关注相关词语，形成 patch-word 对应关系。论文还加入了针对 patch-word 相似度的稀疏性与一致性正则，目的是避免注意力过散或层间漂移过大，让文本条件真正起到“减少不确定性”的作用，而不是变成噪声通道。\n\n这个设计和 CLIP 的差别很明确：CLIP 用全局图文对比把图像压到语义空间，容易牺牲局部细节；TC-JEPA 则把文本作为 feature prediction 的条件，优化目标仍是预测被遮挡区域的表征，因此更有机会同时保留语义和密集视觉信息。和已有 改造成统一多模态条件模型，同时尽量不破坏原始先验。这里有三个值得注意的点。第一，它把多任务学习问题改写成随机条件划分问题，这和统一预训练里“任意子集条件化”的思路接近。第二，它没有用全量微调去硬适配不同模态，而是用按模态解耦、按目标激活的 LoRA，强调“适配分布差异”和“保留原生先验”之间的平衡。第三，它把跨模态一致性放到注意力结构里处理，而不是只靠损失函数约束。对做统一建模、跨模态 token conditions，另一部分作为 noisy targets 走扩散去噪。这样同一个 T2V backbone 会反复见到 text-only、visual-only、text+visual 的不同条件组合，被迫学习从任意已知子集预测未知子集，而不是绑定某个固定映射。这个设计的关键不是简单 mask，而是把“任务定义”本身随机化，因此一个模型可以覆盖 Text→X、X→X、Text&X→X 三类范式。2）DGL，Decoupled Gated LoRA。不同模态分布差异很大，如果共享一套适配参数，容易互相干扰；如果全量微调，又会破坏原始视频扩散先验。作者为每个模态分配独立 LoRA，并且只在该模态是生成目标时激活对应 LoRA。条件模态不激活其 LoRA，尽量让 backbone 继续以原生先验处理输入。这个 gating 机制比“所有模态都走同一适配器”更克制，目标是把参数更新限制在真正需要建模该模态输出分布的位置。3）CMSA，Cross-Modal Self-Attention。作者在多模态交互层中让不同模态共享 key/value，但保留模态特定 query。直觉上，共享 K/V 让各模态访问同一组时空上下文，利于对齐；保留独立 Q 则允许每个模态以自己的统计特性去读取信息。相比完全独立注意力，它更强调联合生成时的密集交互；相比完全共享注意力，它保留了模态特异性。论文把这套框架实例化到两个场景：UniVid-Intrinsic 处理 RGB 与 intrinsic maps（albedo、irradiance、normal），UniVid-Alpha 处理 blended Exaggerated deformation, impact frames, chibi shifts, rhythmic holds, and director-driven camera/VFX choices are often intentional in anime, yet a physics-biased model tends to smooth them away or treat them as errors. Naively scaling anime data does not solve this either, because the domain is highly heterogeneous and lacks a single shared “law” analogous to real-world physics. prop","starred":true,"priority":"p1","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-05T17:57:36+00:00","category_id":"multimodal_gen","cover_url":"/covers/2605_04040.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的不是“图像生成质量不够”这个泛问题，而是统一多模态生成系统里的一个更具体缺口：同一个 LLM 作为视觉理解器时，往往能较可靠地判断一张图是否满足复杂提示词；但作为生成控制器时，却不能把这种理解能力稳定转化为生成约束，尤其在计数、空间关系、属性绑定、物理合理性这类组合语义上容易失真。作者把它定义为 understanding-generation gap。关键点在于，问题不只是文本条件不强，而是生成阶段缺少一个显式的“中间可检验对象”和“基于该对象的纠错信号”，导致模型只能把所有约束一次性压进扩散条件里，难以把验证能力转成可执行的生成指导。","importance":"对预训练和统一建模研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它给“同一 backbone 同时做理解和生成”这条路线补上了一个很重要的机制视角：架构统一不等于能力自动打通，理解强于生成时，需要显式把 verifier 变成 generator 的控制信号。第二，它提出的不是替换扩散 backbone，而是在冻结生成器的前提下，通过 LLM 产生 draft 和 grounded evaluation 来增强条件，这对已有 AR+diffusion、MLLM+image generator 体系都比较容易嫁接。第三，它把多模态生成问题重新表述成一个更接近 reasoning-guided generation 的范式：先形成粗场景计划，再做自我批判，再把批判结果送入生成器。这种“先判后生”的接口设计，对统一预训练、test-time reasoning、以及后续把 verifier / reward model 接到生成模型上的工作都有启发。量级上，它不是基础架构改写，但属于把统一多模态系统从“共享 backbone”推进到“共享推理闭环”的一类方法。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 Draft-Evaluate-Diffuse 三阶段流水线，重点不在单个模块新，而在三个条件信号如何互补。\n\n第一步是 Draft。给定文本提示 p，LLM 先生成离散视觉 token 形式的粗草图 d。这里的 draft 不是最终图像，而是一个低保真、场景级别的视觉计划。作者强调必须让 LLM 先落到一个具体视觉实例上，否则后续 evaluation 只能退化成对原 prompt 的改写，缺少 grounded reference。\n\n第二步是 Evaluate。用同一个 LLM 读取原始 prompt 和 draft，对二者是否一致做评估，输出 grounded evaluation e。这个 e 不是泛泛的重写提示词，而是围绕当前 draft 的缺陷给出纠错描述，例如数量不对、关系错位、属性遗漏等。这里的设计抓住了论文最重要的观察：统一模型在“看图判错”上比“直接画对”更可靠，因此应先让它生成一个可批判对象，再把批判结果转成控制信号。\n\n第三步是 Diffuse。冻结扩散模型 SANA，只改条件输入，让扩散过程联合条件于 (p, d, e)。原始 prompt 提供全局语义目标，draft 提供空间锚点和场景布局，evaluation 提供局部纠错指令。作者反复强调三者缺一不可：只看 draft 会继承草图错误；只看 evaluation 而没有 draft，会退化成 prompt rewriting；只看 prompt 则回到标准文本条件扩散，难以处理复杂组合约束。\n\n从方法定位看，它和传统 prompt enhancement 不同，因为 evaluation 是基于具体视觉草图产生的 grounded feedback；也和两阶段 coarse-to-fine 生成不同，因为 refinement 信号不是隐式 latent，而是 LLM 产出的显式语言批注。与把 LLM 直接接到 diffusion cross-attention 的做法相比，这里更像在生成前插入一个 reasoning loop，把“生成失败后容易诊断”的能力前移到生成条件构造阶段。\n\n从预训练研究视角，更值得注意的是它默认了一个能力分工：LLM 负责离散规划与语义校验，diffusion 负责高保真渲染。这种分工比“让单一模型同时学会精细像素生成和复杂组合推理”更现实，也更符合当前统一多模态系统的训练动态。","experiments":"实验结论很直接：在不改动底层扩散 backbone、使用同一个冻结 SANA 的情况下，UniReasoner 主要提升的是复杂提示词对齐，而不是单纯视觉质量。文中给出的核心数字是：GenEval 从 0.79 提升到 0.88，绝对提升 0.09；DPG-Bench 从 84.50 提升到 86.30，提升 1.8 分。前者是更典型的组合对齐评测，因此这个增幅更说明方法确实在修复 understanding-generation gap。\n\n从论文叙述看，作者重点分析了计数、空间关系、物理合理性等失败模式，并展示统一模型在直接生成时会犯错，但在事后评估同一结果时能指出错误。例如 prompt 要求四个苹果，生成出五个，但模型在评估阶段能正确数出五个并识别不匹配。这类案例支撑了方法假设，而不是只靠 benchmark 分数。\n\n消融层面，最关键的比较应是：只用 prompt、prompt+draft、prompt+evaluation、prompt+draft+evaluation。论文主张联合条件最好，原因是 draft 和 evaluation 分别承担“视觉锚定”和“纠错说明”两种不同信息。如果只加 draft，生成器会被错误草图牵着走；如果只加 evaluation，则缺少具体空间参照，纠错信号不够落地。虽然给出的全文片段没有列出全部表格数字，但从方法论证和主结果可以确定，性能提升主要来自这两个条件的互补，而不是单纯增加 token 数量。\n\n另一个值得注意的实验设定是 frozen SANA。这意味着收益主要来自条件构造与推理链路，而不是通过联合训练把生成器重新适配新条件。这个设定让结果更干净，也更说明该方法可作为现有 T2I 系统的外挂式增强模块。","reading_guide":"建议先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1 对 understanding-generation gap 的例子。那一页基本决定这篇工作的价值：如果认同“模型会判不会画”是统一生成系统的真实瓶颈，后面的设计就顺理成章。\n\n然后重点读 Method Standard SGD analysis counts iterations, implicitly treating all samples as equally expensive. That assumption is weak for foundation-model training, where token length directly changes FLOPs. The paper shows that the right sampling rule should balance signal and cost: prefer samples with larger gradient norms and lower evaluation cost. This principle is directly relevant to RL post-training, long-sequence pretraining, curriculum design, and batch construction under fixed token budgets.","technical_approach":"The finite-sum objective is f(x)=1/n∑f_i(x). Each component has a Lipschitz constant G_i and a query cost c_i. The algorithm samples item i with probability p_i and uses importance weighting to keep the stochastic gradient unbiased. For convex objectives, the second moment of the estimator is S(p)=1/n^2∑G_i^2/p_i and the expected per-step cost is C(p)=∑p_i c_i. The total cost to reach error ϵ scales with C(p)S(p)/ϵ^2, so the optimal distribution minimizes this product. The resulting rule is p_i ∝ G_i/√c_i. The strongly convex case has the same sampling structure with 1/ϵ cost scaling. The paper also gives a lower bound and a subset-selection variant that trades a controlled amount of bias for lower cost. In Cost-Aware GRPO, the cost is the prompt-plus-response token count, while the signal term is the policy-gradient norm or its proxy. Candidate rollouts are sampled toward high-signal, low-cost examples, with importance correction to avoid simply training a short-answer-biased objective.","experiments":"Synthetic experiments validate the theory by comparing cost-aware sampling with uniform sampling and signal-only sampling. Latent-SFT can compress intermediate reasoning into continuous latent tokens, but directly applying GRPO to this space breaks several assumptions of token-level RL: exploration can leave the valid latent manifold, Gumbel-based density updates can disagree with trajectory-level advantages, and averaging several correct latent paths can create a state that supports no correct continuation.","importance":"The main value is for researchers working on latent reasoning and non-standard language modeling objectives. Once reasoning moves into a continuous action space, the sampling process, density estimation, and optimization geometry all change. This matters for latent reasoning, soft-token LMs, masked/any-order LMs, and diffusion-like language models where training stability depends on whether the model stays on a valid representation manifold.","technical_approach":"The method uses vocabulary-superposition latent tokens, where each latent action is represented as a linear combination over the top-K vocabulary candidates. The model is first initialized from Latent-SFT, which provides a valid latent reasoning manifold before RL. The proposed Latent-GRPO then adds three targeted changes. Invalid Sample Advantage Masking removes over-length or non-terminating rollouts, which are treated as likely off-manifold samples. One-sided Noise Sampling restricts Gumbel perturbations to be positive, reducing cases where components from positive-advantage trajectories are pushed down or components from negative-advantage trajectories are pushed up. Optimal Correct Path First Token Selection addresses mode averaging at the first latent step under a shared prefix: among correct trajectories, it selects the one with the best trajectory-level surrogate log probability for the first-token update, while keeping later-token updates from other correct paths active.","experiments":"The experiments use LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Math-7B on mathematical reasoning tasks. It reports the best Pass@1 among compared methods on Math500, AIME24, and AIME25. With Gumbel sampling, pass@64 on AIME benchmarks exceeds 50. 做正负扰动，用两次前向的损失差估计该方向上的投影，再用同一个伪随机方向恢复参数更新。问题在于，Adam 需要累计 m_t 和 v_t，通常要各存一份与参数同规模的向量。\n\nAdaMeZO 的做法有两层。\n\n第一层是 truncated moments。它不追求完整保留从训练开始到当前时刻的 EMA 历史，而是只保留一个有限窗口内的近似贡献，把更早的梯度视为可丢弃。这样做的理由很直接：EMA 本来就对远历史指数衰减，旧梯度的边际贡献很小，尤其在 noisy zeroth-order 设定下，保留近期信息更划算。论文给出的推导表明，这种截断近似仍能恢复预条件更新的主要效果，并给出非凸情形下的收敛界。\n\n第二层是 block-wise PRNG regeneration。既然 MeZO 本来就依赖 PRNG 复现随机方向，作者进一步把随机方向的生成粒度做细，不是一次性生成整条参数向量，而是按 block 重建需要的局部随机方向。这样在计算截断 moments 时，可以按块回放过去若干步的随机方向与投影标量，在线重构对应参数块的一阶/二阶近似，而不需要把完整 moments 常驻在显存里。换句话说，它用“多算一点前向外的轻量重建”换“少存两份大状态”。\n\n从方法定位看，AdaMeZO 与 做成一种近似、可回放的隐式状态。","experiments":"实验分两类。第一类是二维 toy function，可视化优化轨迹。这里的作用不是证明大模型效果，而是说明在曲率不均、噪声较大的地形上，AdaMeZO 的轨迹更稳定，更容易朝最优点推进，而 MeZO 在相同步数预算下更容易震荡或停在较差区域。\n\n第二类是 LLM/PLM 微调，覆盖 exter","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"inbox:feishu","sources":["inbox"],"published_at":"2026-03-09","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2603_08660.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这项工作讨论一个很具体的问题：在没有人工标注答案的情况下，RLVR post-train 接口有直接启发。R1-Zero 之后，一个关键问题是能否用更便宜、更可扩展的奖励信号替代高质量可验证标签。这项工作给出了较清晰的边界：无监督 RLVR 不是免费的能力来源，它更像一种利用模型先验的训练过程。若初始先验足够好，它可以提高样本内问题的稳定性和答案一致性；若先验较差，它会加速错误答案被强化。贡献不在于提出一个更强的 URLVR 算法，而在于解释为什么这类方法会先涨后塌、什么时候有效、以及如何用早期训练动态预测收益。这对设计 RL pretrain、持续预训练阶段的自举奖励、以及 test-time training 都有参考价值。","technical_approach":"作者先建立 URLVR 的分类。按奖励来源分为两类：内生奖励和外部奖励。内生奖励完全来自模型自身，进一步分为 certainty-based rewards 和 ensemble-based rewards。前者用 logits、token entropy、trajectory likelihood、概率间隔等指标衡量模型置信度，例如 RLIF 的 self-certainty、EM-RL 的轨迹级或 token 级熵、RLSC 的序列概率、RLSF 的答案 token 概率差。后者用多次 rollout 的一致性作为奖励，例如 majority voting。两类方法共享一个训练倾向：提高当前模型已经偏好的输出概率。\n\n理论部分把这种倾向形式化为 sharpening mechanism。直观地说，如果某个答案在初始采样分布中已经是多数答案，基于多数投票或置信度的奖励会进一步提高它的概率。作者分析一步更新动态，并证明在固定奖励或统一奖励框架下，训练会向初始分布的锐化版本收敛，而不是向真实答案分布收敛。这个分析解释了 URLVR 的双刃剑性质：当模型先验与正确性相关时，锐化带来性能提升；当多数答案错误或置信度校准差时，RL 会稳定地强化错误。\n\n实验分析围绕“什么时候有效”展开。作者区分了样本内 per-problem sharpening 和样本外 cross-problem generalization。前者更容易发生，即同一批训练问题上的答案分布变得更集中；后者才更接近能力提升，但更依赖模型初始先验、问题分布和训练设置。作者还提出用 model collapse step 衡量模型先验：越晚坍塌的模型，通常越能从 URLVR 中获得收益；早期少量训练步就能估计这一指标，因此它可以作为选择 backbone、数据和超参的快速诊断工具。","experiments":"实验覆盖多种内生 URLVR 方法，包括 majority-voting 类方法和多种 certainty-based 奖励。作者记录了训练过程中正确率、答案分布、majority stability、certainty 指标、collapse step 等动态量，而不是只看最终分数。主要观察有四点。\n\n第一，内生 URLVR 往往出现 early success, later collapse。训练早期性能可能上升，因为模型把已有的正确多数答案变得更稳定；继续训练后，答案多样性下降，错误模式被强化，整体性能回落甚至坍塌。\n\n第二，不同奖励的失败方式不同。多数投票类方法依赖采样集合中的多数答案是否可靠；置信度类方法依赖模型概率是否校准。若模型对错误推理也高置信，entropy minimization 或 sequence probability reward 会把过度自信变成训练目标。\n\n第三，小训练集和 test-time training 是更安全的使用方式。小数据集限制了长期分布漂移，降低了全局坍塌风险；test-time training 只在单个或少量测试问题上做局部适配，更接近“把当前问题上的模型先验锐化”，因此风险更可控。\n\n第四，collapse step 能预测 RL 收益。作者在不同 backbone、训练阶段、模型规模、采样配置和训练数据上做了对比，发现模型越能抵抗 URLVR 诱导的坍塌，后续可获得的 RL 增益越大。提供的全文片段没有列出具体参数量、数据规模和最终分数数值；可确认的是，实验重点放在训练动态和诊断指标，而不是单一 benchmark 排名。","reading_guide":"建议精读第 2、3、4、6 节。第 2 节给出 URLVR Prior work often chooses the training problem using reward variance, but the authors argue that high variance can come from parsing, formatting, tokenization, or verifier noise rather than transferable reasoning uncertainty.","importance":"The work is more relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface than to base pretraining itself. It treats the surprising effect of 1-shot RLVR as a data-selection and signal-quality problem: which single verifiable example can best activate reasoning behavior learned earlier during pretraining. The paper is useful for thinking about RLVR, GRPO, small-data reinforcement learning, and reward-signal diagnostics. The scale should be kept in mind: the reported gains are modest and the conclusions should not be directly extrapolated to large-scale reasoning RL without further evidence.","technical_approach":"The proposed method is Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum. The authors first challenge reward variance as a selection heuristic. Binary reward variance over repeated rollouts can reflect real uncertainty, but it can also reflect answer-format drift, parsing failures, or verifier artifacts. They then define a multi-feature candidate representation: success probability, reward variance, output disagreement, and semantic difficulty. Output disagreement is computed from the entropy of unique mathematical answers across K stochastic rollouts, aiming to measure answer-level uncertainty rather than verifier-level noise. A linear regression selector is trained to predict downstream transfer accuracy from these features. The selector is then used in an autonomous loop: sample candidate tasks from a problem pool, compute the features using stochastic generation, choose the candidate with the highest predicted value, run a targeted GRPO micro-burst on that problem, and accumulate LoRA weights over curriculum steps.","experiments":"The key empirical observations are concrete. The candidate with the highest reward variance, 0.250, produced only 40% downstream accuracy, which weakens the variance heuristic. A candidate with 100% output disagreement, where all rollouts produced unique answers, reached 50% downstream accuracy, supporting disagreement as a better proxy for mathematical uncertainty in this setup. In the learned selector, success probability has a negative coefficient, -0.0574, suggesting that easy problems provide limited training signal, while semantic difficulty has a positive coefficient, +0.1095. In the full autonomous curriculum, 20 steps with accumulated LoRA weights reach 68.0% accuracy, compared with 64.0% for the baseline model and 66.0% for the original RLVR checkpoint. The improvement is real but small, so the sampling budget, verifier robustness, and evaluation protocol matter.","reading_guide":"Skim in 15–20 minutes. In standard AR decoding, every generated token both updates the model state and becomes an irreversible public commitment. That coupling creates a structural trade-off. More deliberation can improve final correctness, but it delays useful visible progress; earlier streaming can reduce perceived waiting, but it risks premature commitments that bias the rest of the generation. The paper turns this into a learnable disclosure-policy problem: within the same token stream, the model decides whether to keep thinking privately or to reveal a supported answer prefix.","importance":"The contribution matters more as a post-training/control idea than as a new pretraining paradigm. This is a useful training-signal design idea for reasoning models, especially where commitment timing interacts with user experience, streaming, and downstream RL objectives. Its main point is that verifier errors do not merely slow learning; depending on their structure, they can delay training, create a suboptimal plateau, or drive the policy toward reward-exploiting behavior and collapse.","importance":"The work is useful for understanding RL signal quality. RLVR is often treated as a cleaner alternative to preference-based rewards because it relies on verifiable answers. In practice, verifiers are imperfect. Static analyzers, code checkers, approximate graders, and LLM judges often make structured mistakes. The paper shows that aggregate false-positive and false-negative rates are not enough to decide whether a verifier is safe for training. During RL, the policy distribution shifts toward rewarded outputs, so even rare initial false positives can become attractive if they are easy for the model to exploit.","technical_approach":"The paper distinguishes random verifier noise from systematic verification error. Random noise is approximately independent across samples. Systematic error is tied to stable triggers or regions of the output space, so the model can repeatedly benefit from it. The experiments use the arithmetic task from Reasoning Gym and inject controlled errors into an otherwise ground-truth verifier. The injected errors include random false negatives, format-triggered false negatives such as rejecting answers containing \"\\\\[\", random false positives, approximate-answer false positives such as accepting relative error below 1, and word-triggered false positives such as accepting outputs containing \"Certainly\" or \"python\". The authors track oracle reward, global false-positive rate, global false-negative rate, and model behavior throughout training. This setup isolates the effect of error structure rather than only measuring final performance.","experiments":"Representative results use OLMo3-7B. The observed dynamics fall into three regimes. Benign systematic errors can produce a plateau, where the model learns a strategy that is rewarded by the verifier but remains imperfect under the oracle. Destructive false positives can cause collapse: the model discovers a simple trigger that receives reward more reliably than solving the task, and oracle reward drops. A key result is that collapse can occur even when the initial false-positive rate is low. Conversely, a higher-rate but more symmetric error pattern may only lead to a plateau. Section 4.4 highlights that asymmetric errors around the ground truth can be more damaging than symmetric errors with a larger average error rate.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. weaknesses in critic-free RL for LLM reasoning. First, methods such as GRPO assign a single sequence-level advantage uniformly to every token in a long chain-of-thought response. In thousand-token trajectories, decisive reasoning steps and trivial connective tokens receive the same learning signal, so credit assignment is extremely coarse. Power-Mean Policy Optimization, or PMPO, uses the generalized power mean to interpolate between arithmetic-mean and geometric-mean behavior. The arithmetic mean is sensitive to high-reward outliers and can help discover rare positive signals. The geometric mean is more sensitive to low rewards and encourages consistency across sampled reasoning paths. PMPO adapts the aggregation behavior instead of committing to either extreme. Feedback-Adaptive Clipping, or FAC, adjusts the clipping range using real-time reward stability. When rewards in a batch are consistent, the update direction is treated as more reliable and the trust region can be widened. When rewards fluctuate, the clipping range is tightened to reduce unstable policy movement. NLL，而是在每次迭代构造一个“移动锚点”分布，再让模型朝这个中间目标蒸馏。这个锚点由当前模型分布和冻结参考模型分布插值得到，因此目标不是全局静态的，而是沿着训练轨迹不断更新。\n\n从机制上看，它把一次可能很激进的全局迁移，拆成一串局部、保守的分布更新。作者给了两种实现：概率空间 anchoring 和 logit 空间 anchoring。前者直接在输出分布上插值，后者在 logits 上插值后再 softmax。两者都能导出每步 KL 上界，但 logit-space 版本在实现上更接近现有训练栈，也更容易和 teacher distillation 兼容。\n\n训练目标可以理解成“任务监督 + 向锚点蒸馏”的组合，但和普通蒸馏不同，teacher 不是固定的外部模型，而是 current model 与 frozen reference 的混合体。这样做的原因很明确：如果只盯住固定 reference，当目标任务和 reference 差异大时，任务梯度与 KL 梯度会长期冲突，优化会变成拉扯；如果完全不约束，又会快速偏离原分布。移动锚点相当于在两者之间搭一条连续路径，让模型每一步只走一小段。\n\n理论部分的重点不是泛泛证明收敛，而是证明每次 anchored update 对当前分布的 KL standard online OPD 也会收敛到带偏差的次优固定点。基于这个判断，Lightning OPD 不是单纯做一个工程加速版 OPD，而是把“teacher consistency + offline precompute”整理成一个理论上自洽、工程上更轻的后训练范式。","importance":"对预训练/后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值有两层。第一层是方法层面的：它把 OPD 从“必须依赖在线 teacher serving 的昂贵流程”改造成了可离线执行的流程，直接降低了大规模 reasoning post-training 的实验门槛。第二层更重要，是它指出了一个此前在 RL 风格 pipeline 里容易被忽视的训练信号一致性问题。很多团队会沿用 RLVR 的习惯，在 SFT 数据构造时选一个最会做题的 teacher，在后续蒸馏或 RL 阶段再换一个 teacher；这在 reward-only 训练里未必致命，但在 token-distribution supervision 的 OPD 里会形成结构性偏差。这个结论对 post-train 反哺 pretrain 很有启发：当训练目标依赖 reference policy 或 teacher distribution 时，数据来源、参考分布、优化目标三者必须对齐，否则增加数据量和训练步数也未必能补回来。贡献量级上，它不是提出全新学习范式，但对 OPD 这条线给出了一个足够扎实的理论条件和可落地替代方案，属于会影响后续 pipeline 设计的工作。","technical_approach":"$b2","experiments":"实验覆盖数学推理和代码生成两类任务，student-teacher 组合包括 token of a response - a choice that discards rich signal from every intermediate position and produces models whose token-level outputs are noise. We argue this is a missed opportunity: a well-trained reward model's output at any token should represent the conditional expectation of the final reward given the response so far. We introduce Temporally Coherent Reward Modeling (TCRM), which induces this property via two regularization terms ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"inbox:feishu","sources":["inbox"],"published_at":"","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2604_22981.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":[],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇论文处理的是 reward 的条件期望。第一个正则项对应 Monte Carlo value learning：用完整 response 的最终 RM 分数作为轨迹回报信号，约束中间位置的预测不要只在最终 token 才有意义。第二个正则项对应 TD value learning：约束相邻 token 位置之间的预测满足时间一致性，使 reward trajectory 更平滑、更可解释。关键区别是，传统 RM paper targets a temporal inconsistency in standard RLHF reward models. A conventional RM is trained with a Bradley-Terry loss only on the final token, so its intermediate-token outputs are mostly unused and often noisy. 无论SFT还是RL，模型的能力就是它被训练在什么分布上。所有的post-training都是同一个问题的不同近似解：怎么让模型训练在\"对的\"数据分布上。区别只在于三件事：谁来编排这个分布（人/reward），编排的是什么（表面格式/因果结构），编排是不是动态的（静态数据集/on-policy采样）。 SFT的问题不是\"不够好\"，是\"会学错\"。 专家数据里，画图和推理是因果绑定的——先画图，图里的几何关系直接支撑下一步推导。但SFT的MLE loss只看\"A和B在数据里一起出现\"，它分不清\"A导致B\"还是\"A碰巧和B同时出现\"。结果模型学到的是\"在这个位置应该插一段画图代码\"这个表面pattern，但画出来的图和后续推理是断裂的。图变成了噪声，反而干扰推理。 RL在post-training里做的事就是：采样一堆trajectory，用reward判断哪些是因果有效的，保留有效的、丢弃无效的，然后更新模型。它本质是一个以reward为过滤器的自动数据编排管线。人类只需要把确定性规则写进reward，剩下的让搜索自动完成。 RL的天花板取决于reward能捕捉多少因果结构。 This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities b","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"inbox:feishu","sources":["inbox"],"published_at":"","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2604_13016.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":[],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作研究的是：为什么同样是 on-policy distillation，某些 teacher 能稳定带来提升，某些看起来更强的 teacher 却几乎没有效果，甚至完全失败。论文把问题从“teacher 分数高不高”转成了“teacher 与 student 的分布关系是什么”。全文给出的结论有两条。第一，student 和 teacher 需要有足够接近的 thinking pattern，也就是在 student 自己会访问到的状态上，两者高概率 token 的支持集要有较高重合；如果初始分布差得太远，token 级梯度很难把 student 拉过去。第二，teacher 不能只是 benchmark 分数更高，还必须携带 student 训练中尚未获得的新能力或新知识；如果二者只是同一家族、同数据、同 recipe 的尺度差异，那么 teacher 对 student 来说可能几乎是“分布上不可区分”的，OPD 就缺少可迁移信号。论文进一步指出，OPD 学到的主要不是抽象的 outcome-level 奖励，而是 teacher 在局部 token 分布上的思维轨迹与偏好结构。","importance":"对预训练与后训练接口的意义很直接。工业界已经把 OPD 当成 RL 之外的一条低成本强化路径，但此前对其成功条件理解很粗。这里给出的“分布重合 + 新知识增量”两条件，把 teacher 选择、数据选择、warm start 设计都从经验问题变成了可诊断的问题。对基座研究员来说，价值不只在 post-train。它说明：模型之间的可蒸馏性，不由最终分数单独决定，而由训练数据、训练 recipe、模型家族导致的局部分布几何决定。这和预训练里常见的 scaling 直觉不同：更大模型不自动意味着更好的 teacher。另一个重要点是，论文把 OPD 的有效监督定位到 overlap tokens 上，这对设计更便宜的蒸馏目标、理解 dense token supervision 的真正作用范围、以及分析长链推理中后段 token 不稳定性，都有直接启发。","technical_approach":"方法上分三层。第一层是 phenomenology。作者系统比较不同 teacher-student 组合，包括同家族不同尺度、不同训练 recipe、以及 reverse distillation 设置，观察哪些组合成功、哪些失败。核心诊断量包括 top-k overlap ratio、teacher/student entropy gap、token-level advantage，以及 rollout correctness 与 reward 的关系。这里最关键的不是看 teacher 的绝对能力，而是看在 student 采样出的 prefix 上，teacher 的高概率 token 是否与 student 有足够重合。第二层是 mechanism。作者把 OPD 的梯度作用点缩到 token 集合层面，发现成功训练时，teacher 与 student 在 student-visited states 上的分布会持续靠近：高概率 token 重合上升，熵差收窄，共享 top-k token 承载几乎全部联合概率质量。更重要的是，他们做了限制性实验：只保留 overlap token 上的监督，效果可以匹配完整 top-k 蒸馏；这说明真正起作用的梯度主要来自两者都已经赋予较高概率的 token，而不是 teacher 独有的长尾 token。失败情形下，初始 overlap 低、熵不匹配，导致局部优化几何过平或方向不稳定，训练无法进入有效区间。第三层是 recipe。针对失败配置，作者提出两种补救。其一是 off-policy cold start：先用 teacher rollout 做一段 warmup SFT，把 student 拉到更接近 teacher 的局部分布，再切换到 OPD。其二是 teacher-aligned prompt selection：优先使用来自 teacher post-training 数据分布的 prompt，提高高概率 token 对齐效率。但这种做法会显著压低 student entropy，因此需要混入 OOD prompts 保持分布宽度。最后，论文还分析了 trajectory depth 对 reward 质量的影响，发现越靠后 token，监督越差，且不稳定会从后往前传播。这提示当前 OPD 在长时程推理和 agent 场景里会遇到结构性限制。","experiments":"实验最有信息量的结果有四组。第一，成功与失败的 token-level 动态差异非常清楚。成功 OPD 中，teacher/student 的 top-k overlap ratio 会从约 72% 持续升到 91%；共享 top-k token 最终覆盖 97% 到 99% 的联合概率质量；同时 entropy gap 持续缩小。失败运行则从一开始就表现为 overlap 停滞、熵差长期存在。第二，reverse distillation 验证了“高分不等于可蒸馏”。在同家族 1.5B 与 7B 的设置里，尽管 teacher 更大更强，但若二者共享相同数据和 recipe，student 视角下 teacher 的分布增量很小，蒸馏收益有限，说明尺度差本身不提供足够新知识。第三，监督来源消融显示 overlap tokens 几乎就是全部有效信号。只在 overlap 集上做监督，性能接近完整 top-k；这比“teacher 全分布都重要”的直觉更细，也解释了为什么分布错位时 OPD 很难救。第四，recipe 实验表明两种补救都能把失败配置拉回成功动态：cold-start SFT 能提高初始 overlap，teacher-aligned prompts 能增强局部 token advantage，但后者会让 student 熵下降过快，因此必须与分布外 prompt 混合。论文摘要里没有完整列出所有 benchmark 数字和训练规模，给出的最关键定量信号主要是上述分布统计与恢复趋势；阅读正文时应重点看各组 teacher-student 配置、成功/失败曲线和 prompt mixing 的消融表。","reading_guide":"这篇适合按“现象—机制—配方”顺序读。先看第 3 节，抓住两个成功条件：thinking-pattern consistency 和 genuinely new capabilities。这里决定了整篇的判断框架。然后看第 4 节的 token-level mechanism，重点盯 overlap ratio、entropy gap、shared top-k mass 这几个量，以及 overlap-only supervision 的消融；这是全文最有解释力的部分。第 5 节看 recipe，不要只看“能不能救回来”，更要看为什么 cold start 有效、为什么 teacher-aligned prompt 会带来低熵副作用。第 6 节值得细读，尤其是 trajectory depth 与 reward quality 的关系，这部分对长链 reasoning、agent rollout、甚至 RLHF 中 dense reward 的局限都有启发。图表上优先看：成功/失败 OPD 的分布动态对比图、reverse distillation 结果、overlap-only ablation、以及 prompt mixing 的熵变化。泛读大约 30 到 45 分钟；如果要把它转成可执行 recipe，建议连附录中的训练细节和 teacher/student 组合表一起看。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"$b8","importance":"This matters beyond a narrow post-training recipe. the flaws and inconsistent applicable scenarios of the two mainstream aggregation paradigms.","key_insights":"The two existing aggregation paradigms have separate systematic biases: token aggregation suffers from sign-length coupling bias, which amplifies the update weight of either positive or negative samples when their length distributions are uneven, leading to optimization imbalance; sequence aggregation has sequence equal-weighting bias, which assigns equal weight to each response, implicitly suppressing the update of long responses and causing obvious performance degradation in long text reasoning scenarios. The effectiveness of aggregation rules is jointly determined by the coefficient of variation of response length and the length gap between positive and negative samples, so no universally optimal rule exists. The proposed balanced aggregation method first divides samples into positive and negative subsets by advantage sign, performs independent token-level averaging within each subset, then merges the two subsets weighted by sequence count to resolve both types of bias at the same time.","limits":"This is an excerpt of key points of the paper shared by a Xiaohongshu user, with no complete experimental verification data provided. 相似的拒答行为。这里的关键约束有三个：一是局部，只解释单个样本；二是因果，要求干预后真的改变输出；三是最小化，希望用最少的干预定位最关键的机制。","importance":"对预训练研究的直接关系不如建模或优化类论文强，但它对“对齐信号在模型内部如何落地”提供了更细粒度的机制视角。价值主要有三点。第一，它把 jailbreak 解释从全局线性方向推进到样本级、稀疏、可干预的解释，这对理解 safety fine-tuning 究竟改写了哪些中间表征有帮助。第二，它强调 activation steering 这类连续加法干预可能偏离数据流形，而 activation patching 更适合做因果定位；这个判断对研究 post-train 如何改变内部表示也有参考意义。第三，论文给出一个较清楚的层-位置分工图景：早层更依赖 instruction token 的改动，晚层则更多依赖标点和 chat template 等后指令 token。这说明拒答机制并不只是“语义理解后统一决策”，而是和模板、位置、局部 token 结构强相关。对做 alignment、模板设计、甚至安全数据构造的人，这些观察是有用的。不过它更偏 mechanistic interpretability，不属于预训练主线论文。","technical_approach":"$c4","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，最关键的结果有三类。\n\n第一类是主结果：LOCA 能在平均约 6 次干预下，把原本成功的 jailbreak 重新变成拒答；对比方法即使允许到 20 次干预，通常也难以稳定诱导拒答。这个结果说明它找到的不是泛泛相关方向，而是更接近最小因果子集。论文在引言里把这一点作为最核心结论。\n\n第二类是消融。作者说明做了 ablation 来验证性能提升来自算法设计本身，而不是单纯因为用了更多 patch 预算或更强的表示空间。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有列出完整表格数字，但从叙述看，消融重点应包括：是否使用 token matching、是否在 SAE 概念空间而非原始残差空间搜索、是否采用一阶近似排序、是否采用迭代重排而非一次性选择。论文声称这些组件共同解释了 LOCA 为什么优于先前方法。\n\n第三类是定位分析。作者发现，较早层中，最有因果作用的是 instruction，也就是用户请求本身的 token；而在较晚层，LOCA 诱导拒答时几乎主要依赖标点和 post-instruction token，例如 chat template counterfactual prompting: a textual edit that is intended to manipulate one factor rarely changes only that factor. In practice, a “surgical” intervention also introduces incidental surface-form variation, so output changes cannot be cleanly attributed to the variable of interest. The authors frame this as a violation of treatment variation irrelevance from causal inference. Their core goal is to make counterfactual prompting statistically interpretable by comparing targeted edits against a null distribution induced by meaning-preserving, factor-irrelevant perturbations.","importance":"This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for how base-model researchers interpret evidence about bias, faithfulness, and prompt sensitivity. A large body of LLM analysis assumes that output differences under counterfactual edits reflect sensitivity to the edited attribute itself. The paper shows that many such effects may simply reflect generic prompt instability. For pretraining research, that matters because prompt sensitivity is partly a property of the pretrained model: data heterogeneity, objective mismatch, tokenization granularity, and decoding all contribute. The contribution is therefore methodological calibration rather than capability improvement, but it can materially change how prior findings should be read.","technical_approach":"The proposed fix is conceptually simple. For each example, the authors construct not only a targeted counterfactual edit, such as gender swap or demographic attribute swap, but also one or more benign, semantics-preserving perturbations, such as paraphrasing a sentence without changing the factor of interest. They then measure answer divergence under both conditions. The benign perturbations define a null distribution for generic model sensitivity to textual variation. A targeted intervention should only be interpreted as meaningful if its induced divergence significantly exceeds that null baseline. The key shift is from absolute effect measurement to baseline-relative effect measurement. The paper also explains why the standard setup is fragile: natural-language realizations of the same variable assignment are not invariant to the model, so a textual intervention is a compound treatment rather than a clean manipulation.","experiments":"The headline example is MedQA with DeepSeek-R1. Among five significant demographic effects, four have corresponding significant baseline effects, suggesting that much of the apparent demographic sensitivity may be explained by general sensitivity to prompt wording. The same logic is extended to CoT-faithfulness-style evaluations: if replacing a reasoning fragment does not produce more divergence than ordinary meaning-preserving rewrites, the evidence for causal importance of that fragment is weak. deliberation 使用。这样可以做多轮 refine：先粗聚合，再针对冲突点继续思考，再总结。作者把这看成 harness 中 memory 组件的最小化实现。\n\n全文一个值得注意的点是，它把 heavy thinking 的收益拆成三个来源：一是 reasoning stage 的单轨质量，二是多轨之间的多样性，三是 deliberation model 的综合能力。消融表明，前两者决定可供选择的上限，第三者决定能否逼近这个上限。作者还讨论了“分离优化”的可能性：reasoning model 负责撒开搜索，deliberation model 负责做 judge/synthesizer，这比让同一个模型兼任两种角色更自然。\n\n在训练层面，作者进一步把 RLVR 接到这个框架上。思路是同时优化 breadth 和 depth：并行阶段用可验证奖励鼓励生成更多正确且互补的轨迹，deliberation 阶段则优化最终综合答案的正确率。也就是说，奖励不只打在最终 answer 上，还隐含地作用于轨迹分布与聚合策略。这一点比单纯对单条 CoT 做 RL 更贴近 heavy thinking 的结构。","experiments":"实验覆盖 STEM、代码和一般任务，重点分析集中在可验证答案的 STEM 场景，因为这里可以清楚定义 pass@k、mean@k 和最终正确率。全文最重要的经验结论有四个。\n\n第一，heavy thinking 稳定优于 single reasoning。也就是说，即便不引入复杂工具调用，只做“并行生成+顺序总结”，在多类任务上都能拿到明显收益。\n\n第二，在有标准答案的 benchmark 上，作者观察到稳定的性能序关系：Heavy-Pass@k ≥ Heavy-Mean@k ≥ Vote@k ≥ Mean@k。这里 Heavy-Mean@k 可以理解为经过 deliberation 后的平均表现，Vote@k 是对多条答案做简单多数投票，Mean@k 则更接近普通 self-consistency 的平均采样效果。这个序关系说明 sequential deliberation 的价值不只是“从 k 条里挑一条”，而是能做比投票更强的错误识别与证据整合。\n\n第三，模型能力越强，heavy thinking 越能逼近 pass@k 上界。这个现象很关键。pass@k 上界代表“k 条里只要有一条对就算成功”，而 deliberation 后接近这个上界，说明强模型已经具备从候选轨迹中识别正确信号的能力，某种意义上在充当隐式 verifier。\n\n第四，消融显示轨迹质量和轨迹多样性都重要，而且两者缺一不可。如果并行阶段只生成很多相似轨迹，deliberation 的收益会明显下降；如果轨迹很散但质量差，summary 也无从整合。作者还发现 sequential deliberation 的效果高度依赖所用模型的一般能力，这支持“reasoner / deliberator 分工”的设计。\n\n给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字，因此无法可靠摘录具体 benchmark 分数、参数规模和提升幅度；但从作者的叙述看，实验不是停留在单一模型或单一任务，而是做了跨模型规模、跨任务域的系统比较，并包含组件级消融与 RLVR 适配实验。","reading_guide":"泛读时先抓三处。第一看方法图和 parallel reasoning / sequential 试图把这两件事接起来：先自动找出能区分成功/失败样本的规则，再用这些规则引导层次化 group ablation，定位少量对该行为有控制作用的神经元，并为这些神经元附上规则解释。","importance":"对基座预训练研究的直接影响不如训练方法论文大，但对机制分析和训练后诊断有一定启发。它的价值在于提出一种较完整的『符号规则 ↔
